# The Floor Lords Crew (Classic Floorlords)
> Boston's longest-running hip hop breaking crew, founded in 1981. 45 years of breaking, performance, education and community.

Canonical site: https://www.floorlords.org/

## Quick facts
- Founded in Boston, Massachusetts in 1981
- Featured in Krush Groove (1985), Step Up 3D (2010) and In The Heights (2021)
- Performed with RUN DMC, Madonna and Jennifer Lopez
- Saucony collaboration on the first official breakdance sneaker
- August 6 is Floor Lords Day in the City of Boston
- FL Studio, Harvard Square, Cambridge MA
- 45th Anniversary weekend: September 11 to 13, 2026 (Downtown Throwdown at Downtown Crossing, Mass Appeal, and The Middle East in Cambridge)

## Book the Floor Lords
- Performances for events, shows, festivals and brand activations
- Breaking workshops and hip hop culture education for schools and youth programs
- Battle judging and event hosting
- Email: floorlordsboston@gmail.com
- Phone: (857) 488-2888
